latin: Sicut quilibet philosophus habet dicere quod uirtutes sensitiue sunt in corde, ita quilibet medicus habet dicere quod sint in cerebro.
latin_note: The sheet's line-break slash in 'sensitiue / sunt' is repaired to a space.
translation: Just as it falls to every philosopher to locate the sensitive faculties in the heart, so it falls to every physician to place them in the brain.
translation_note: Farmer's note (farmer1998:20170) reads this as a secular double-truth harmonizing Aristotle and Galen; both claims form Pico's own reconciling formula rather than a report of a single ascribed view, so pico_stance is given as endorses.
